mapper.select: select mber_no , ntcn_setup_code , aplctn_recptn_at , email_recptn_at , sms_recptn_at , creat_mber_no , creat_dt , change_mber_no , change_dt from mber_ntcn_iem_setup where mber_no = #{mberNo}

select c.mber_no , a.ntcn_setup_code , a.ntcn_setup_nm , a.ntcn_setup_cn , a.ntcn_ctgry_code , a.icon_nm , c.aplctn_recptn_at , c.email_recptn_at , c.sms_recptn_at from ntcn_setup_iem a join ntcn_setup_iem_role b on a.use_at = 'Y' and a.ntcn_setup_code = b.ntcn_setup_code and b.use_at = 'Y' and b.role_id = #{roleId} left join mber_ntcn_iem_setup c on b.ntcn_setup_code = c.ntcn_setup_code and c.mber_no = #{mberNo} order by a.sn asc
mapper.insert: insert into mber_ntcn_iem_setup ( mber_no , ntcn_setup_code , aplctn_recptn_at , email_recptn_at , sms_recptn_at , creat_mber_no , creat_dt , change_mber_no , change_dt) select #{mberNo} , #{ntcnSetupCode} , coalesce(nullif(#{aplctnRecptnAt}, ''), dflt_aplctn_recptn_at) , coalesce(nullif(#{emailRecptnAt}, ''), dflt_email_recptn_at) , coalesce(nullif(#{smsRecptnAt}, ''), dflt_sms_recptn_at) , #{creatMberNo} , current_timestamp , #{changeMberNo} , current_timestamp from ntcn_setup_iem where ntcn_setup_code = #{ntcnSetupCode}
